name: Pavano Trades
notes: Research pulls live portfolio state from Alpaca paper API. Weekdays only.

gemini.prompt_template:
Today is {today}. Search for:
- market_context: 2-3 major market-moving events today (Fed, earnings, macro)
- options_education: 1 clear plain-English concept about options trading relevant to current market conditions

Return JSON: {"market_context":[],"options_education":[]}
Each item: title, summary (2 sentences), source, date. Return ONLY valid JSON.
